status: design proposal; calibrate against one captured webOS 2.x build before claiming conformance
reference: Palm Pre 2 webOS 2.x phone interaction model

device_profile.name: LG Fx0
device_profile.profile_status: design target; hardware input and backend timing require device verification

physical_home_button.status: proposed binding, enabled only after verifying the actual input capability
physical_home_button.input_mapping: resolve from verified input capability and observed device mapping; do not hardcode a numeric keycode
physical_home_button.while_locked: never unlock, authenticate, or expose protected cards

geometry.compact_target_policy: status, gesture and keyboard have equivalent accessible routes; do not silently extend hitboxes over clients
geometry.search_overflow_policy: scroll further actions vertically; one New message action visible initially at full text size

theme_contract.scope: shell-owned surfaces and cooperative sample app chrome; arbitrary client buffers retain their submitted pixels
theme_contract.icon_policy: pictorial app icons and browser content illustration retain their original colors
theme_contract.gradient_policy: themeable UI gradients have separate IDs from original icon gradients

compositing.scope: Fx0 Gold; other themes retain their original opacities

theme_contract.wallpaper_treatment: original static engraved and foil linework, quiet center, restrained edge detail
theme_contract.text_contrast: Gold endpoint pairs audited; final text compositing and device rendering still require review

motion_status: starting values from later LunaSysMgr config, not a captured Pre 2 timing match

gesture_proposals.start_zone: reserved strip only for shell navigation

compositor_budget_proposal.status: proposal; not measured on an LG Fx0 runtime
compositor_budget_proposal.cache_scope: Tarot-owned cached previews only; excludes client surfaces and total process RSS
compositor_budget_proposal.live_preview_policy: focused and visible neighboring cards only
compositor_budget_proposal.eviction_policy: least recently used cached previews first under memory pressure
compositor_budget_proposal.blur: precomputed shadows; no continuous full-screen blur
compositor_budget_proposal.render_cadence: derive from the actual backend timing; no verified 60 Hz assumption

content_disclaimer: Fictional contacts and app data. App interiors show cooperative design targets, not automatic GTK or Qt restyling.
